description: Post a message to your agency team in the shared Slack channel pinned in your own client space, sent by the BAMF Slack bot and attributed to you (e.g. "Jonathan (via Muse)"). Requires team_channel:write. TWO-STEP: confirm=false (default) returns the plan and exact preview text and sends nothing; call again with confirm=true only after the user approves the exact preview. Replaying the same idempotency_key never posts twice.

confirm.description: false returns the plan only; true posts.

text.description: The message as the team should read it.

workspace_id.description: Client space workspace id from bamf.list_creator_spaces. Optional when you belong to exactly one space.

name: bamf.message_team_channel
